label: Reasonable suspicion
meaning: Reliable information points this way, enough to keep looking, not enough to rely on.

label: Reasonable grounds to believe
meaning: Enough consistent, reliable information that an ordinary careful person would believe it.

label: Balance of probabilities
meaning: More likely than not, once the alternatives are weighed.

label: Clear and convincing
meaning: Highly probable; the alternatives considered are set aside on the evidence.
